Equipment: Lot scanner, caliper, DMM, incoming reference set
Control and inspection: Match A1 revision and display flex, 1200 mAh pack, connector keys, SKU variants and fastener head/length; inspect pouch and trace supplier documentation.
Record or release: Serial-linked incoming inspection, packing slip, measured critical dimensions, lot and discrepancy disposition

Equipment: Calibrated printer, build profile, go/no-go fixtures
Control and inspection: Print controlled STL orientation and material lot; remove supports from dovetail, key tracks, lens, encoder seat and channels. Check receiver clearance, cap recess and seating against reference gauges.
Record or release: STL checksum, material lot, slice parameters, actual grams/time and gauge results

Equipment: Carrier Gerbers, fixture, soldering station, microscope
Control and inspection: Confirm carrier stock and 1.0 mm finished holes. Mount SW1 on isolated pads; dress joints to 0.8 mm envelope. Verify open/rest and contact pair before bonding harness.
Record or release: Fab lot, coupon thickness, solder inspection, continuity and key travel

Equipment: Wire cut/strip/crimp tools appropriate to selected terminals, DMM, pull tester
Control and inspection: Freeze authoritative connector PN/pin order for both ends. W1 I²C, W2 measured pack adapter, W3 key, speaker and optional motor each get service slack, insulation and anchors. No soldering directly to cell tabs.
Record or release: Harness drawing revision, cut lengths, polarity witness and supplier pull-limit results

Equipment: Torque driver, seating jig, magnet polarity indicator
Control and inspection: Install H8 and keeper before closure. Fit rotor, diametric magnet from correct axis, fold hinge/shims/grip. Check unobstructed right-side sweep, magnet capture and shaft alignment.
Record or release: Adhesive lot/cure, torque and spin check. Record prototype values until torque release

Equipment: Registration fixture, inert max-pack gauge, visual inspection
Control and inspection: Seat encoder and speaker, route from moving parts and antenna. Fit optional driver/M1 with validated tape or retention. Trial-close using inert pack before fitting received undamaged battery.
Record or release: Variant, clearance photos, strain relief and closed-case inspection

Equipment: USB power meter, current-limited source, torque driver
Control and inspection: Fit SW1 and top cap, secure retainer and W3, connect board and main harness. Independent polarity check before pack insertion. Keep glass free of bezel load; tighten to signed process torque.
Record or release: Board/pack serials, tool ID, measured cap travel, screw log and seam inspection

Equipment: USB data fixture, verified image, access-controlled provisioning station
Control and inspection: Flash correct 16 MB configuration. Verify digest, board ID, API and firmware build. Provision only owner-approved public verification key and endpoint. Retain private keys outside the line.
Record or release: Flashing log, readback/hash, serial and calibration record

Equipment: Two-pose motion jig, encoder reference, audio coupler, battery emulator, test harness
Control and inspection: 9/9 touch grid on USB and pack, cast/lift, both reel directions, haptics if fitted, key holds, speaker, battery gauge, UTC sync, radio and shared-event smoke. Recheck power after close.
Record or release: End-of-line report tied to calibrated fixture, result per check and rework disposition

Equipment: Scales, artwork master, barcode scanner, packaging sample
Control and inspection: Verify personal brand, SKU, serial, region labels, battery shipping rules, accessory variant, support information and contained parts. Segregate failed units.
Record or release: Approved traveler, packaging lot and shipping records. Record first-pass yield and warranty reserve from actual lots
